product.name: Wide High Jeans
product.description: 5-pocket jeans in rigid cotton denim. Loose fit from seat to hem with extra room around legs. High waist, zip fly with button, and dropped gusset. Designed for everyday wear.

materialDetails.name: Recycled cotton
materialDetails.description: Recycled cotton is cotton made from textile waste in production or from end-of-life textile waste. The waste is mechanically recycled and spun into new yarn.

materialDetails.name: Recycled polyester
materialDetails.description: Recycled polyester is polyester made from PET bottles or end-of-life textile waste. The PET bottles or textile waste is mechanically recycled and processed into new yarn.
